dz: 英格兰的亨利一世与苏格兰的玛蒂尔达结婚,玛蒂尔达是苏格兰的马尔科姆三世的女儿,也是萨克森国王埃德蒙·铁边的直系后裔;玛蒂尔达同日加冕.
de: Henry I of England marries Matilda of Scotland, the daughter of Malcolm III of Scotland and a direct descendant of the Saxon king Edmund Ironside; Matilda is crowned on the same day.
